The so-called '''Emperor's Tower''' was a [[Mooring tower/Legends|mooring tower]] that served as the residence, seat of power and command center of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], leader of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], aboard the [[Death Star II/Legends|second]] [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]]. Designed by [[Bevel Lemelisk]] and inspired by the spires of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], its penultimate story had a quadripartite structure, housing a giant [[Holomap/Legends|holomap]], a [[Emperor's Throne Room/Legends|throne room]], private quarters and a [[Docking ring/Legends|docking ring]]. It was destroyed along with the rest of the Death Star during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].

==Description==
[[File:ITW_Emperors_Tower.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The quadripartite structure of the tower's penultimate story]]
A 100-story spire that rose from the northern pole of the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]],<ref name="SWCL" /> the so-called [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] Tower served as a special command center from which [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] could survey the intended targets of his [[Moon/Legends|moon]]-shaped, 160 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] wide [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]]. Although a [[Window/Legends|windowless]], armored chamber hidden in the depths of the Death Star would have been a better strategical choice, Emperor Palpatine's great sense of the dramatic favored a more spectacular structure. By sitting from the top of his colossal needle, the Emperor had the highest vantage point on the battlestation and made a statement of his superiority.<ref name="FF99">{{FactFile|99|DEA 21-22|Second Death Star &ndash; Throne Room}}</ref> The Emperor's Tower was designed to be reminiscent of the [[High Council Tower/Legends|southwest spire]] of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="Commentary">{{Film|VI}} DVD {{C|Audio Commentary}}</ref> where the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|High Council]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] used to convene. However, Palpatine's tower was isolated, while the Jedi Council's spire was only one of the five that crowned the Temple. That difference showed that Palpatine was entirely in control of his Empire and did not answer to any council.<ref name="S&V 9">[[Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection 9|''Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection'' 9]]</ref>

Given the importance of its resident, the Emperor's Tower was protected by an unusually large concentration of [[XX-9 heavy turbolaser/Legends|XX-9 heavy turbolaser]] [[Turret/Legends|turrets]], all with improved fire control and placed at intervals of as little as a few hundred [[Meter/Legends|meters]].<ref name="SWCL" /> Additional defenses included [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]], overlapping [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]] [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|generators]], and [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]] patrol patterns.<ref name="FF99" /> In addition, the tower itself received the most heavy shielding of the entire station, and its hull was doubly reinforced so as to ensure that it was protected from incoming [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]].<ref name="DSOTM">''[[Death Star Owner's Technical Manual]]''</ref> All in all, the north pole of the second Death Star was one of its most heavily guarded areas,<ref name="FF99" /> ensuring that it was virtually impenetrable from the outside. In addition, an emergency throne room was located within the armored sphere just below the tower, in the event that the tower itself suffered structural damage.<ref name="DSOTM" /> For internal defenses, the corridors leading to the throne room and royal quarters as well as the tower itself were loaded with traps and various other security measures, with any personnel approaching the corridor leading to the tower's restricted [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] being required to punch in an identifying code before entering the trap-filled passageway. The penalty of failing to identify themselves properly were subject to either immediate capture or being instantly killed by laserfire.<ref name="DSOTM" />

A large, open shaft that plunged deep into the station's [[Reactor/Legends|reactor core]] housed a cluster of four turbolifts than ran the length of the tower. The penultimate story of the tower was a four-lobed compartment that acted both as a command center and a private sanctum.<ref name="FF99" /> One lobe contained a [[Docking ring/Legends|docking ring]] that allowed visitors' [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to moor at the isolation tower. Opposite the mooring area was a vast room containing a giant [[Holomap/Legends|holomap]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. That map highlighted [[Planet/Legends|planets]] and [[Star system/Legends|solar systems]] that were to be conquered or chastised. A third lobe housed the [[Emperor's Throne Room/Legends|Emperor's Throne Room]], and a fourth one contained a luxuous receiving area as well as Palpatine's private sleeping chamber. The tower's summit was covered in [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] and [[Communications array/Legends|communications arrays]], and was crowned by a girdle of [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]].<ref name="SWCL" /> The main area itself was also split into three levels: The gantry stretched above the central floor, the throne room itself, and the royal living quarters and the quarters for the [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Emperor's personal bodyguards]]. Depending on whether either the throne room itself or the royal apartment were occupied, it was guarded either by four [[Squad/Legends|squads]] of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] (unoccupied), or by the same amount of squads for the Imperial Royal Guard (occupied).<ref name="DSOTM" />

==History==
The construction of the second Death Star was ordered by Emperor Palpatine in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], while a [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first]], smaller Death Star had just been completed. Ironically, that first battlestation, however, was [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|destroyed]] at the hands of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] shortly after Palpatine issued the construction order.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> Because of that drawback, many facets of the original design were altered. As part of that redesign, Palpatine had his chief designer, [[Bevel Lemelisk]], construct a special command center for the second Death Star.<ref name="FF99" /> In order to appeal to the Emperor's sense of theater, Lemelisk suggested the addition of a tall tower at the northern pole of the new battlestation.<ref name="FF99" /> Around eight [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the loss of the first Death Star, the isolation tower had been completed, as the Emperor granted an audience to [[Captain of the Line/Legends|Senior Captain]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] in its throne room area.<ref name="COO" />
